data: Which line is the highest at k = 300?

The question asks which line is the highest at k = 300. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the impact of the number of principal components (k) on parsing accuracy (UAS, LAS). The lines in the figure represent UAS and LAS scores. At k = 300, the red square represents UAS, and the black circle represents LAS. 

Looking at the graph, the red square (UAS) appears higher than the black circle (LAS) at k = 300. Therefore, the line representing UAS is the highest at k = 300.
